notes.title: New Year's big update! Agari and Endless Mode! Ver2.0
notes.notes:
【Update】
・More than one game mode added!
　- 3 minutes mode
       This is the traditional mode of SushiVR!

   - Endless Mode
　　This mode allows you to play endlessly until the number of complaints reaches 5!
　　Compete for a score based on how long you play and how satisfied you are until the game is over!
　　If you make a mistake in ordering or exceed the time limit, you will get 1 complaint meter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964548/555a0efe823080cec73545bcc038e34c3d44817e.png

・Game difficulty system added.
　- Matsu (Easy)
 　　This is the traditional mode of SushiVR!
　　 This is a sushi-only mode.
   
   - Bamboo (Normal)
　　There is tea (agari) and time limit for each customer.
       　

・Tea (Agari) is added.
　　Take the teacup to the faucet and tea will be served.
　　Fill it with just the right amount of tea and give it to the customer.
　　Too much is not good!
　　Depending on the quantity, the time limit and the amount of change in satisfaction will vary!
　　
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37964548/fb95aed2513a03424366bc32adf4dbd4cb0f7886.png

・Add customer satisfaction.
　　It's the customer's satisfaction level!


・Make sure the plate stays after eating!

・Rankings have been moved from Steam's system to our own system!
　　Steam's ranking didn't support multiple columns!
　　

[Fixed]
The UI is now responsive even outside of sushi!



We will continue to make updates and fixes periodically.
We're looking forward to your feedback and suggestions!
We welcome your reviews on Steam, tweets about our scores on Twitter, videos on Youtube, etc.!

In the future, we plan to implement a tutorial-like mode and a management mode!
We'd love to hear your feedback.

We look forward to working with you on SushiVR in 2021!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update!
notes.notes:
【Update】
・The controller is not displayed on the hand!
・Implemented an automatic height adjustment function. With Oculus Touch, pressing the X button automatically adjusts.

【Fixes】
・Fixed the problem that the sound effect of the dish was not stereophonic.
・Fixed the problem that the sound effect is large.
・Fixed the problem in which the balance of sound effects was not reflected from the settings.

We will continue to make regular updates and corrections.
We'd love to hear from you, the manager!

We are very grateful to the community for reporting their opinions.
Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
【Update】
・Customers are now taking various reactions! Never throw anything at customers...
・Customers throw sushi.
・Implemented more sound effects.

【Fixes】
・Fixed an issue where the shari generation range was extremely wide.
・Fixed a bug that sushi can not be grasped when providing the wrong product.

We will continue to make regular updates and corrections.
We'd love to hear from you, the manager!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
【Update】
・Customers are now ordering sushi continuously! One dish won't fill you up.
・Sound effects and letters are displayed when sushi is served.
・Implemented a ranking function linked to Steam. Let's fight with managers all over the world!

【Fixes】
・I made it impossible to jailbreak from the counter. Don't get out of work!
・Fixed a bug that sushi can not be grasped when providing the wrong product.

We will continue to make regular updates and corrections.
We'd love to hear from you, the manager!
